excerpt.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
excerpt.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

texts.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
texts.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

sections.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
sections.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
texts.en:
A surface expedition to [from.GetName] located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

label.zh: 她的经验可是无价之宝。
给她一艘飞船和一些物资。
label.en: Gift her a shuttle and supplies.

label.zh: 真有趣。摧毁她的庇护所。

texts.zh:
一位形容枯槁的[scru_species.GetClass]走出她改装为居所的外勤站。当她谈及自己在[from.From.GetName]上的遭遇时，从她[scru_species.GetMouthName]中发出的声音沙哑破碎；言语断断续续。

“请原谅……我已经很多年……没有和人说过话了……”
texts.en:
An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on [from.From.GetName], the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.

"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."

label.zh: 你为什么落难到这里了？

responses.zh: 我当时正在勘测[from.From.GetName]，记录基岩的独特特征。我的船员说他们要驾驶探测飞船简单检查一下。我信了他们。焦虑了几天后，我才意识到，他们直接开回家了。
responses.en: I was surveying [from.From.GetName], cataloging the unique bedrock. My crew said they'd do a quick sweep in our exploration craft. I believed them. Only after a few days of worrying did I realize what had happened. They took off and flew home.

label.en: How did you survive here for so long?

responses.zh: 哦，真是奇妙啊。只要稍微改造细胞通透性，再让热休克蛋白过度表达……之后，要在我改造的细胞上诱导大自噬就简单得多了。而多亏了这个世界丰富的钠含量，我得以烹制出许多美味佳肴。
responses.en: Oh it's a wonder what you can do when modifying cell permeability and hyper-expressing heat shock proteins... After that, it was simple to induce macroautophagy on my modified cells, and thanks to the sodium content of this world I could generate many savory meals.

label.zh: 你还想和同类们重见吗？
label.en: Do you not want to rejoin your own kind?

responses.zh: 他们不配拥有我在这块岩石上取得的突破。我根本不想知道他们抛弃我的神经借口。
responses.en: They don't deserve the breakthroughs I've made on this rock. I don't care to learn what duplicitous reasons they had for abandoning me.

label.en: What can you do for us?

responses.zh: 我已经厌倦在简陋的实验室工作。我渴望从太空去看新世界。
responses.en: I'm tired of working in a makeshift lab. I want to see new worlds... From space.

tooltips.zh: 斯科露作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
tooltips.en: Scru joins our empire as a Leader.
